movers.text: D Quinn Hughes (27.8 TOI, upper body) will miss the rest of Minnesota's road trip, including tonight at SJ (Joe Smith, The Athletic, via ESPN, 11/21).
RW Beckett Sennecke (20.3 TOI, upper body) went on IR 11/21 and C Leo Carlsson (19.8, upper body) is day-to-day (The Athletic, 11/22); Ryan Poehling (knee) is on IR.
LW Artemi Panarin (21.4 TOI) is day-to-day after missing 4 games; D Erik Gustafsson (19.7) and Trevor Moore (16.2) are also day-to-day for the MTL game.
D Mike Matheson (23.5 TOI, lower body) is out about 2-3 weeks from 11/15, per the Canadiens; Josh Anderson (lower body) is out 3-4 weeks.
D Dylan DeMelo (19.4 TOI, lower body) is expected to be out 4-6 weeks from 11/19, per the Jets' official site.
